displayName: Generate tailored interview questions from a candidate's LinkedIn
summary: Get interview questions tailored to each candidate's actual background.

useCases.title: Generate tailored interview questions from a candidate's LinkedIn
useCases.message: Help me prepare interview questions for a candidate. Ask me who I'm interviewing and for which role. If you don't already know which ATS I use, ask. Then go to their LinkedIn profile and check their application in my ATS. Read their background and experience, and write a set of tailored questions that probe the most relevant parts of their history.
